1.say: Drape the blue striped tie around the white collar. Hang the wide end down the front on your right. Hang the narrow end down the front on your left much shorter.
placements: wide blue striped end → hanging down the front of the white shirt on your right side as you face it, much longer with tip low; in the video: right side of frame hanging off the bottom edge
narrow blue striped end → hanging down the front of the white shirt on your left side as you face it, much shorter; in the video: left side of frame with dark tip visible
watch_for: if the wide end is shorter than the narrow end, you started backwards and the knot will run out of length
if the tie twists around the collar, the stripes will not lie flat and the knot will bunch
1.check_yourself: The blue tie lies flat around the white collar with both ends hanging down the shirt front and the wide end much longer.

2.say: Hold the narrow blue end steady in the center. Bring the wide blue end across it below the collar.
placements: wide blue striped end → laid over the front of the narrow blue end to form a cross at the center of the shirt just below the collar; in the video: center of frame forming an X below the white collar
watch_for: if the narrow end sits on top of the cross, the ends are reversed and the knot will twist
if the cross sits high inside the collar, slide it down to leave room for the wrap
2.check_yourself: The two blue ends form a clear X centered just below the collar with the wide end on top.

3.say: Pass the wide blue end behind the narrow end. Pull it up through the neck loop behind the cross.
placements: wide blue striped end → passed behind the cross and pulled up through the neck loop between the collar and the cross, pointing upward; in the video: center top pointing up toward the collar opening with the crossing cinched below
watch_for: if the cross pulls apart as you lift, you went in front of the loop instead of behind it
if the wide end lies over the collar, guide it through the neck loop opening only
3.check_yourself: The wide blue end points up through the neck opening with the crossing pinched snug below the collar.

4.say: Bring the wide blue end down and across the front. Lay it flat to form a horizontal band with the tip to the side.
placements: wide blue striped end → wrapped down and across the front of the knot as a flat horizontal band with the tip sticking out to the side; in the video: horizontal band across the center with tip to the side, match the picture for left or right
watch_for: if the wrap twists edge on, flatten the blue fabric so the stripes lie smooth
if the band sits above the crossing, bring it down to cover the center
4.check_yourself: A flat horizontal blue band covers the center with the wide end sticking out sideways.

5.say: Lift the wide blue end up behind the neck loop. Thread it down through the front horizontal band.
placements: wide blue striped end → lifted up behind the neck loop then threaded down through the front horizontal band to hang centered over the narrow end; in the video: hanging down the middle of the chest over the narrow end
watch_for: if the wide end comes out beside the band, it missed the loop and the knot will fall apart
if the narrow end shows in front, tuck it behind so the wide end covers it
5.check_yourself: The wide blue end hangs down through the front wrap centered over the narrow end.

6.say: Pull the small narrow blue end downward to tighten the knot. Slide the triangular blue knot up snug under the white collar.
placements: triangular blue knot → pinched and slid up to sit centered just under the front edges of the white collar; in the video: centered under the collar at the top of the shirt
wide blue striped end → straightened to hang straight down the center of the shirt front over the narrow end; in the video: down the middle of the frame
watch_for: if the knot tilts sideways, center it before it gets tight or it will sit crooked
if the wide end twists, flatten it so the stripes run straight down the shirt
6.check_yourself: A neat triangular blue knot sits centered under the collar with the wide end hanging straight down the shirt.
